_comment: Corrections to the identity keywords derived from skill data. Keys are identity ids (1SSNN). `skills` is how many base attack skills inflict the keyword — the unit conditional gifts count. `special: true` means the identity inflicts a 특수 variant (특수 화상 etc.), which the '및 특수 X' form of a condition requires. Identities listed here get keywordSource: "curated".
